title: Practice 1: Where to: в and на

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Диван в ___ (лифт, acc. sg.) не влезет.
exercises.prompt: The couch won't fit in the elevator.
exercises.why: **лифт → лифт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Экран моего телефона перестал реагировать на ___ (нажатие, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: My phone screen stopped responding to presses.
exercises.why: **нажатие → нажатия** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate. Declines like здание (A. pl. здания). Ending -е → -я.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Этна извергнулась, отправляя лаву и пепел в ___ (сицилийское небо, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Mount Etna has erupted, sending lava and ash plumes into the Sicilian sky.
exercises.why: **небо → небо** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **сицилийский → сицилийское** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with небо). Declines like русский (A. русское). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Белка лезет на ___ (дерево, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The squirrel is climbing the tree.
exercises.why: **дерево → дерево** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том отнёс два ящика в ___ (кладовая, acc. sg.) комнату.
exercises.prompt: Tom carried two boxes into the storage room.
exercises.why: **кладовая → кладовую** (acc. sg.). Feminine. A noun that declines like an adjective. Ending -ая → -ую.  «Больной, раненый and знакомый are often used as adjectival nouns.» — DLI, Lesson 57.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Мы сели на ___ (автобус, acc. sg.) в Синдзюку.
exercises.prompt: We got on the bus at Shinjuku.
exercises.why: **автобус → автобус** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том не верит в ___ (эволюция, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom doesn't believe in evolution.
exercises.why: **эволюция → эволюцию** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like армия (A. sg. армию). Ending -я → -ю.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я хочу на ___ (неделька, acc. sg.) к своим съездить.
exercises.prompt: I want to visit my folks for a week or so.
exercises.why: **неделька → недельку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ты меня в ___ (краска, acc. sg.) вгоняешь.
exercises.prompt: You're making me blush.
exercises.why: **краска → краску** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я ходила на ___ (твой сайт, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I went to your website.
exercises.why: **сайт → сайт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **твой → твой** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with сайт). Declines like мой. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том и Мэри играли в ___ (русская рулетка, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom and Mary played a game of Russian roulette.
exercises.why: **рулетка → рулетку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **русский → русскую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with рулетку). Declines like русский (A. русскую). Ending -ая → -ую.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Наклей на ___ (конверт, acc. sg.) марку.
exercises.prompt: Stick a stamp on the envelope.
exercises.why: **конверт → конверт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том подложил в ___ (огонь, acc. sg.) дров.
exercises.prompt: Tom put some more wood on the fire.
exercises.why: **огонь → огонь** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like автомобиль (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том сделал упражнения на ___ (растяжка, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom did some stretching exercises.
exercises.why: **растяжка → растяжку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он приехал во ___ (вторник, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: He arrived on Tuesday.
exercises.why: **вторник → вторник** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Посланец из далёкой Солнечной системы вышел с нами на ___ (связь, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: An emissary from a distant solar system has contacted us.
exercises.why: **связь → связь** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like часть (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я часто впадаю в ___ (уныние, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I often get the blues.
exercises.why: **уныние → уныние** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like здание (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Хлопотно пытаться решить, что надеть на ___ (вечеринка, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: It's a hassle trying to decide what to wear to the party.
exercises.why: **вечеринка → вечеринку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Чувство юмора сослужит вам хорошую службу в ___ (трудное время, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: A sense of humour will stand you in good stead in difficult times.
exercises.why: **время → времена** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate. Declines like имя (A. pl. имена). Ending -я → -ена.  **трудный → трудные** (acc. pl., agreeing with времена). Declines like новый (A. anim. = G., inan. = N). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Завтра я должен идти на ___ (рентген, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I have to go and have an X-ray tomorrow.
exercises.why: **рентген → рентген** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
